metrics.definition: Issues created during the shared measurement window.
metrics.exclusions: Issues created before the window start or after the window end.
metrics.inclusions: Issues whose creation timestamp falls inside the inclusive 90-day window.
metrics.label: Created cohort
metrics.method_summary: Filter issue creation timestamps to the inclusive window, then count the cohort.
metrics.numerator: Issues created from window start through window end, inclusive.

metrics.definition: Share of the created cohort closed by the measurement date.
metrics.denominator: All issues created during the window.
metrics.exclusions: Issues outside the created cohort and cohort members closing after as_of.
metrics.inclusions: Created-cohort members with a closure timestamp on or before as_of.
metrics.label: Cohort closure
metrics.method_summary: Divide closed cohort members by all created cohort members and round to one decimal percentage point.

metrics.definition: Median elapsed time from creation to closure for closed cohort members.
metrics.denominator: Closed members of the created cohort.
metrics.exclusions: Open cohort members, post-as_of closures, and issues outside the created cohort.
metrics.inclusions: Created-cohort members closed on or before as_of.
metrics.label: Median close time
metrics.method_summary: Filter to closed cohort members, divide each elapsed UTC duration by 24 hours, then take the median.
metrics.numerator: Elapsed 24-hour days for each closed cohort member.

metrics.definition: Difference between open backlog at window end and window start.
metrics.exclusions: Backlog observations outside the shared window boundaries.
metrics.inclusions: Open issue counts sampled at both boundaries of the shared window.
metrics.label: Net backlog change
metrics.method_summary: Subtract the opening backlog count from the closing backlog count.
metrics.numerator: Open issues at window end minus open issues at window start.

metrics.definition: Commits reaching trunk during the shared measurement window.
metrics.exclusions: Commits outside the window and changes not recorded on trunk.
metrics.inclusions: Opaque trunk commit records whose commit timestamp falls inside the inclusive 90-day window.
metrics.label: Trunk commits
metrics.method_summary: Count first-parent and merged commits reachable from trunk in-window.
metrics.numerator: Commits reachable from trunk with commit dates inside the window.

metrics.definition: Trunk commits produced by explicitly scheduled maintenance.
metrics.exclusions: Non-maintenance commits and all commits outside the shared window.
metrics.inclusions: In-window trunk commits carrying the controlled scheduled-maintenance classification.
metrics.label: Scheduled maintenance
metrics.method_summary: Classify governed maintenance identities before traceability coverage.
metrics.numerator: In-window trunk commits classified as scheduled maintenance.

metrics.definition: Non-maintenance trunk commits carrying a valid issue reference.
metrics.denominator: All non-maintenance trunk commits in the window.
metrics.exclusions: Scheduled-maintenance commits, outside-window commits, missing references, and references absent from the validated issue set.
metrics.inclusions: In-window non-maintenance trunk commits referencing at least one independently validated opaque issue identity.
metrics.label: Issue-reference coverage
metrics.method_summary: Validate referenced issues after removing scheduled maintenance commits.
metrics.numerator: Non-maintenance trunk commits with a valid issue reference.

metrics.definition: Unique valid issues referenced by non-maintenance trunk commits.
metrics.denominator: Non-maintenance trunk commits with valid issue references.
metrics.exclusions: Duplicate references, invalid references, maintenance-only references, and outside-window references.
metrics.inclusions: Distinct validated opaque issue identities referenced by covered non-maintenance commits in the shared window.
metrics.label: Distinct issues represented
metrics.method_summary: Deduplicate valid issue references across covered commits.
metrics.numerator: Unique valid issue identities represented by in-window commits.

groups.eligibility_rule: Numeric coverage becomes eligible after both the native scoped-session denominator and its durable decision/finding joins are reproducible for every day in a complete 90-day window.
groups.label: Durable record coverage

metrics.definition: Share of scoped sessions producing at least one durable decision or finding record.
metrics.denominator: All reproducible scoped sessions during the window.
metrics.exclusions: Sessions outside the shared window, records outside the shared window, records for unscoped sessions, and duplicate records from the same scoped session after its first qualifying record.
metrics.inclusions: Opaque scoped-session records starting inside the inclusive 90-day window and their in-window durable decision or finding records.
metrics.label: Session coverage
metrics.method_summary: Deduplicate durable records by scoped session before calculating coverage.
metrics.numerator: Scoped sessions with one or more durable records, counted once per session.

groups.reason: A native scoped-session denominator cannot be reproduced for the complete 90-day window.

public_wording.summary: Issue flow and change traceability are independently reproduced across one 90-day window. Durable record coverage remains explicitly not measurable until its native session denominator and record joins are reproducible.
public_wording.title: Operating discipline, measured over one window
